ep00.title: Master Arborescence
ep00.say: Episode 1 — the core. This is the map of the whole operating encyclopedia.
ep00.explain: Document P00 is the Master Arborescence: one hub tree that holds every Tier B deck. From here the fleet is not a pile of slides — it is a living sky you can navigate. Everything we open next hangs from this core.

ep01.title: Vision and Zero-Illusion
ep01.say: Episode 2 — law of the house. Truth before theatre.
ep01.explain: P01 sets Zero-Illusion: no fake done, no cosmetic certainty. PRIME-AI turns intent into routed work, then verifies before close. If a claim has no challenger and no evidence, it is not finished.

ep02.title: AACI and Hub
ep02.say: Episode 3 — how agents talk. Hub to specialist, not chat chaos.
ep02.explain: P02 is AACI: Agent-to-Agent Communication Interface. One hub hears the ask, the router picks a desk, MCP is the shared plug, and any agent can call another as a tool. This is the spine of the fleet.

ep03.title: Keywords and Capacity
ep03.say: Episode 4 — capacity dial. How many minds you wake.
ep03.explain: P03 maps the keyword dial: 1 house, 5 departments, 6 awake, 9 frontier, 12 per mission, 24 roles, 321 roster. Capacity is policy — wake only what the mission needs on M4.

ep04.title: Command Department
ep04.say: Episode 5 — Command wing. Intent becomes mission shape.
ep04.explain: P04 is Command: fleet commander, mission compiler, strategic planner, workflow orchestrator, governance controller. This wing sets the objective and keeps the fleet pointed.

ep05.title: Intelligence Department
ep05.say: Episode 6 — Intelligence wing. Sense before you strike.
ep05.explain: P05 gathers research, OSINT, tech and market intel, competitor read, and knowledge synthesis. Command decides; Intelligence feeds the truth surface they decide on.

ep06.title: Execution Department
ep06.say: Episode 7 — Execution wing. Hands on the work.
ep06.explain: P06 ships the work: coding, QA, Playwright, DevOps, content, outreach, reporting, documents. Specialists wake when tasked — they do not idle on the stage.

ep07.title: Verification Department
ep07.say: Episode 8 — Verification wing. Done means challenged.
ep07.explain: P07 is the challenger desk: fact verifier, security auditor, output critic, evidence collector. Nothing closes as complete until this wing has spoken or evidence is logged.

ep08.title: Infrastructure Department
ep08.say: Episode 9 — Infrastructure. Keep the house standing.
ep08.explain: P08 watches the floor — fleet sentinel and node health. Without this wing, every clever mission collapses into downtime and guesswork.

ep09.title: Frontier Nine and OMNI
ep09.say: Episode 10 — Frontier Nine. Outer scouts under OMNI.
ep09.explain: P09 holds the nine frontier specialists and OMNI unify: ZERO, DEEPSCAN, CLAW, CCR, HERMES, MID, ORACLE, FORGE, and the parade that keeps them coherent. Depth without drowning the hub.

ep10.title: MCP Control Plane
ep10.say: Episode 11 — MCP plane. Tools as hardpoints.
ep10.explain: P10 is the control plane for MCP plugs: sovereign fleet MCP, prime router, iMac SSH, Benjamin fleet, Ollama router. This is how AzIrEm and every agent touch real systems safely.

ep11.title: Substrate Services
ep11.say: Episode 12 — Substrate. Memory under the mission.
ep11.explain: P11 is local substrate: Ollama, NATS, Neo4j, Qdrant, command center, council, voice, ZeroClaw. Ports on localhost — the floor AzIrEm stands on while briefing you.

ep12.title: Cognitive Kernel and Missions
ep12.explain: P12 is the cognitive kernel: intent, planner, research, fleet scheduler, departments, prompt pipeline, consensus, learning, acceptance, evidence. Missions run as verified loops, not one-shot chats.

ep13.title: Nodes and Placement
ep13.say: Episode 14 — Placement. M4 is the active house.
ep13.explain: P13 places the fleet: M4 is the sole active command node in the M4-only profile. iMac, Pi, Synology, VPS stay in the encyclopedia as deferred nodes — not awake noise.

ep14.title: Trust Evidence Governance
ep14.say: Episode 15 — Trust lock. Hash it, keep it, prove it.
ep14.explain: P14 is trust and evidence governance: policy, verify, retain. Every serious claim in this series should land with a trail you can audit — that is Zero-Illusion made durable.

ep15.title: Orb Voice Design System
ep15.say: Episode 16 — Voice of the Orb. How the fleet sounds.
ep15.explain: P15 is the Orb voice and design system — tone, language, and visual grammar so every deck and film feel like one house, not eighteen random brands.

ep16.title: GitHub ORB Ecosystem
ep16.say: Episode 17 — GitHub ORB. Remote control plane.
ep16.explain: P16 ties the encyclopedia to the GitHub ORB ecosystem — source of truth for the control plane, so the live fleet and the documented fleet stay the same story.

ep17.title: yace19ai.com 3D Wire
ep17.say: Episode 18 — you are inside the wire. Series complete for this sky.
ep17.explain: P17 is this 3D site: the wire that lets you walk the tree, call AzIrEm, and download each PPTX. The map and the mission are the same object — that is the point of the live series.
